caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven material with a detailed, textured appearance. The top portion, occupying about two-thirds of the rectangle, consists of interlaced strands in shades of red, grey, beige, and traces of muted green, arranged in a diagonal crisscross pattern. The lower third of the rectangle is filled with a different weave, tightly interwoven in an olive green color, creating a denser and more uniform texture compared to the upper section. The overall composition presents a clear demarcation between the multi-colored upper section and the solid green lower section, all set against a plain, light background.
title: Woven Covering for Chair Back
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
